Mike: heads up — noticed a recurring pattern where warmup probing for new models is queuing behind deep benches and we get a small but visible latency spike for canaries after deploys
Sara: ugh, saw that too earlier today :grimace:
Deepak: are we running probes with the same shard priority as heavy benches? sounds like a scheduling policy issue
Mike: yeah, current scheduler is fairness-first so long benches can starve short probes. idea: add probe priority + targeted shard affinity so short jobs get fast paths
Julia: what about probe fidelity? we can prefer a golden subset for warmup probes instead of full bench to reduce work
Sara: +1 on golden subset. also need to ensure probes still exercise kv-cache/warm paths — otherwise latency improvement is moot
Deepak: proposal sketch: incremental two-tier probe
Julia: ```
# scheduler config example
scheduler:
  probe_priority: high
  probe_targeting: targeted_shards_only
  max_probe_concurrency: 10
  golden_set_size: 50
  fallback_to_full_bench_after: 3h
```
Mike: that looks reasonable. target shards could be the model's hot shards + 1 adjacent to exercise token routing
onboard-bot: Probe job 572 enqueued for model: gpt-lite-3-7b (probe_id=572) :white_check_mark:
Sara: operational questions — how do we avoid gaming (teams creating tiny probes to get fast capacity)? need honest-size enforcement
Deepak: enforce via cost accounting + sample diversity checks. small probes with low diversity flagged and deprioritized
Mike: agree. also add heuristic: if a probe's golden_set overlap with previous probes > 80% mark as redundant and lower priority
Julia: can we add a quick dashboard metric: probe_latency_impact and probe_success_rate so SRE/product can monitor regressions
Sara: I'll open a short RFC + runbook PR. TL;DR: introduce probe priority, targeted shard affinity, golden-subset warmup, and enforcement heuristics. tag ops and infra for scheduling changes
Mike: thanks — can someone take ownership of rollout? I can do the infra change if @Deepak will wire the golden-set selector
Deepak: I'll take the selector. will spin up a POC this week and post results
Mike: great. Sara — add to backlog and link canary incident logs.
Sara: done — https://rwd-internal/boards/ONBOARD-328 (added summary and test plan) :thumbsup:
onboard-bot: Reminder: weekly probe health report generated at 06:00 UTC
Mike: cool. let's reconvene after POC with numbers (reduction in probe time + canary latency delta). thanks team
